mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROOM_RESULT ( RESULT_ID , ROOM_ID , RESTAURANT_ID , GAME_PARTICIPANT_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_ROOM_RESULT.NEXTVAL , #{roomId} , #{restaurantId} , NULL )
